paragraphs: R' Nehunya ben Gudgada. See the entry R' Yohanan ben Gadgada.[^1]

notes.text: Nehunya and Yohanan remain distinct given names, as do גודגדא, Gudgada, and גדגדא, Gadgada. The English vowels are conventional; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
